name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM blockade of Mali's capital continues to choke supply routes
state: JNIM imposed a blockade on Bamako after coordinated attacks on 25 Apr 2026, halting trade on the Kayes–Bamako axis and spreading attacks to the Conakry–Bamako route (ISS). It was last reported in force in July, with Bamako relying on escorted convoys; no report of it being lifted had been found as of 3 Nov, so the status holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
